reviews.x: I really liked these. I'm an ICU nurse and have been working covid crisis ICUs since April. These headbands saved my ears from the surgical masks I wore over the N95 ! The headbands were stretchy and the buttons were sewn snug to the headband.  Plus they were very cute.  I will definitely buy these again!

These things are awful!!! They don’t stay on your head. Mine just keeps sliding off and the buttons are so small. I’m really disappointed I needed something that’s going to stay in place. I can’t take my mask off and redue my headband every ten minutes. Waist of money for me.

these 4 headbands and perfect for comfort during an 8 hour shift with n95 and mask over too! suggest to reinforce the buttons before wearing... 2 of mine fell off mid shift. but very happy with this purchase.
Unfortunately, after 1 wear per headband, all of them lost at least 1 button. Very disappointed
Bought these for my staff due to having to wear masks for 8-10 Hours a day.  All of the users say they are super comfortable and take the pressure off their ears from the face mask.
My only complaint is that one of the headbands buttons are so close together it will not work for a mask.

reviews.t: Broke within the first thirty minutes
reviews.x: I purchased these headbands thinking that they would save my ears from pain. I was wrong. Not only did it break within the first 30 minutes of wearing, I had to buy the product and have my hopes dashed away. Very disappointed in this product hopefully they can figure themselves out before someone else has the same issue as I did.

This headband is very comfortable, soft, and has some stretch to it.  The buttons on the side works great with holding my mask in place and reviling the pain that is caused by the mask when I wear it behind my ears. It also soaks up the sweat when working out so it doesn’t run into your eyes.

reviews.t: They are NOT non-slip as advertised
reviews.x: There is nothing at all non-slip about these. No grip at all and it flew off my head 3 times before I could attach mask. I'm dissapointed because this is the main reason I ordered them. :( If you need non-slip, they aren't for you. If headbands don't slide on you normally, they will be perfect. They are soft and came well packaged.
If you have larger head, these don't stay on. They're too tight and it causes them to slip strangely. I like the button idea though, and they worked fine for my regular headed coworkers.
Both buttons fell off the first time my daughter wore this headband. Buttons are also small making it hard to loop mask.
Lei los comentarios y por los buenos comentarios lo compre.. Y si es super cómodo, adios dolor de orejas!

I love the colors and wear them every day to work. However, these headbands could be a little bigger. They’re very stretchy, but still tight on my head and leave me with a headache around my temples. I work 12 hour shifts though, and they don’t bother me for the first half. Because they’re so tight, talking and eating seem to cause them to get pushed back with my facial movements. My least favorite part was how the buttons were sewn on. The knots were large enough I could feel them pressing my s

Save your money they slip off your head. Bough these for my daughter who wears hearing aids. When she wears hearing aids and a mask and takes off her mask several times she has almost lost one. I thought these would work better for her since the mask would go on the button instead of behind the ear. If you want to try these save some money go to Walmart and get normal headbands and sew your own buttons on it will be cheaper.

reviews.t: 1 week already falling apart; button too small
reviews.x: I'm a healthcare professional and was hoping this would save my ears and help keep me cool with all the COVID PPE, however, after wearing the blue wrap 2 days, the seam is already coming apart. The button is small and I have to have the headband perfectly positioned for the right tension to keep my mask from falling off. I'm sewing on bigger buttons bc I don't have time to wait for more to come in.

reviews.t: My favorite is the black and gray
reviews.x: I love the black and grey one. I wear this pretty much every day to work I love how it holds my ears back and I don't have to worry about putting the mask over my ear lobes (which makes them poke out even more).  I would definitely suggest for health care workers.

I’ve always had a problem with head bands slipping off so if you have that, this isn’t really any different. Totally not the fault of the headband. Buttons are great and at a great spot! Would definitely buy this again and recommend.
Great idea, but as soon as a mask was attached the buttons popped off.
Perfect for my twelve hour work shift. A real ear saver. Washes well.

reviews.t: Great if the buttons stay on
reviews.x: I loved these headbands until a button broke off after 2 wears......

These hand bands are perfect for work! I work in the health industry and dealing with patients all day. Wearing the N95 masks have taken a toll on my ears and got very sore and tender after about 8 hours of use each day. I saw these and thought I’d give them a try. One of my best purchases on Amazon! They’re very soft, comfortable, and convenient. I forget I’m wearing the headband sometimes and my ears are so much better. The fact that they don’t have to wrap around my ears but add enough tensio

reviews.t: Nice headband, but they do slip off
reviews.x: Nice headband with lots of stretch, which make them very easy to put on. My head circumference is 22” from forehead around the back, measuring at the largest part. The buttons are great for the mask. If I wear a mask it helps keep the headband from slipping, but without one I needed to use a bobby-pin on either side to keep it from slipping back. I’m not sure if it’s the material or the stretch that cause them to slip, but they won’t stay in place without the bobby-pins. Overall the headbands lo

reviews.t: Effective until slips off head or rips
reviews.x: I liked these when I first opened them- soft with well-sewn and well-placed buttons (I am an ICU nurse who purchased these to use with my mask at work). However, they are too tight to the point they slip off your head. These are the third set of headbands I’ve purchased because the other two were too loose, so I have not had this problem before. I tried stretching them out with my heads before wearing them and it resulted in the fabric unraveling open at the seams. Now they’re unwearable.

Love them! Have been very handy at work. Especially since I work in healthcare and need to constantly wear a  mask and it helps to keep my hair in place. The only thing is that the bottom part of the headband that goes in the back of my head starts to hurt after a 12-hour shift. This often happens to me with headbands so I'm not sure if it's a "me" problem. I think it's mostly having too much hair and just having this stiff feeling afterward.

Bought these for my wife because she always wears headbands and is required to wear a mask every day for work. They are a little thicker than what I thought but seem to be ok. She has yet to wear them as they are a Christmas gift.  EDIT: My wife loves these, and honestly... so do I. They are comfortable and look great. The buttons hold the mask comfortably and actually make it more comfortable to wear a mask. 10/10 recommend

claims.text: Many reviewers find the headbands comfortable and effective at relieving ear pressure from masks, especially during long healthcare shifts.
A common complaint is that buttons fall off or break, sometimes within the first wear or shift.
Several reviewers report the headbands slip off the head and are not non-slip as advertised.
Some reviewers note the buttons are too small or too close together to hold a mask well.
Some reviewers find the fit too tight, causing discomfort or headaches, particularly for larger heads.
